fields.lean_lines: lines of all .lean files in the repository, dependencies excluded, comments and blank lines included
fields.tier_lines: what the tier is based on: dag.lines when the Lake project covers less than 90% of lean_lines (partial_project), else lean_lines
fields.lake: single = one Lake project (project_dir); multi = several lakefiles and none at the root; none = no lakefile; unknown = not inspected
fields.dag: from the import headers of every .lean file under project_dir (bench/gen/dag_stats.py): modules, depth = longest import chain in modules, max_width = widest level, par_lo..par_hi = total lines / lines on the heaviest chain (plain, and with 100 lines added per module)
fields.sample: true for the graded sample list in README.md
